`r if (exists("overview_heading", inherits = TRUE)) overview_heading else "## Overview"`
`r if (exists("overview_description", inherits = TRUE)) overview_description else "Simplified overview diagram of the pipeline."`

```{r, echo = FALSE, eval = TRUE, results = "asis"}
overview_stem_local <- if (exists("overview_stem", inherits = TRUE)) overview_stem else pipeline_name
overview_mermaid_source <- file.path(repo_root, "website", "figures", paste0(overview_stem_local, "_overview.mmd"))
asset_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "website", "figures")
common_theme <- readLines(file.path(asset_dir, "common_theme.mmd"), warn = FALSE)

emit_mermaid <- function(path) {
  mermaid_lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)

  cat(
    "```{mermaid}\n",
    paste(
      c(common_theme, mermaid_lines),
      collapse = "\n"
    ),
    "\n```\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}

emit_mermaid(file.path(asset_dir, "standard_node_color_legend.mmd"))
emit_mermaid(overview_mermaid_source)
```
